text:
maria: quick thought — proposing a new `log_mode=trimmed` flag on the internal request API to keep headers/attachments but redact user text beyond 256 chars + optional per-tenant consent. trying to reduce token leakage in logs. WDYT?

ash: can we fold into the existing sampler? we already have sticky sampling + TTL. what's the delta? :thinking_face:

maria: good call. delta is deterministic trimming + salted hashing for the truncated portion so we can still link events without storing full prompts. also we want to keep embedding payloads for model debugging but not full raw prompt text.

devon: two concerns: embeddings + attachments. attachments often include base64 metadata. trimming text alone might not be enough. suggest two-tier: metadata-only + hashed payload (no raw).

maria: agreed. rough config idea:
```json
{"log_policy": {"mode":"metadata_hash", "max_chars":256, "hash_salt": "tenant_specific"}}
```
(default `basic | metadata_hash | pii_scrub`).

nora: console impact: dashboards need to show truncated_count + truncated_by_tenant + post_trim_size_histogram. operators will want a clear signal when truncation spikes.

sam: product question — do trimmed events count against debug quota/storage the same as full events? trimming should reduce storage cost, product might want to bill differently. we should surface expected cost delta in console.

linda: legal note: hashed payload + per-tenant salt is OK provided salt isn't logged. retention rules still apply — treat truncated as potential PII unless proven otherwise. prefer `metadata_hash` + short retention for truncated artifacts.

opsbot: deploy scheduled: privacy-rules-v2 -> canary on prod-3 2026-03-30T22:00:00Z

maria: next steps i'll open an RFC with examples + test plan. tentative action items: @devon implement scrub routine, @ash add sampling hook in request-router, @nora add dashboard tiles and metric names, @sam follow up on quota billing, @linda confirm retention language. i'll draft the RFC tonight.

ash: ack. prototyping note: i'll add `log_mode` toggle on request-router with a fallback to tenant-default. will also add RPC `inspect_token` gating for untrimmed view.

devon: for attachments i'll implement a `content_shallow_hash` that preserves mime/type and size but not raw blob. code sketch:
```py
def shallow_attachment_signature(b64blob):
    meta = {"mime": guess_mime(b64blob), "len": len(b64blob)}
    return hmac_sha256(salt, meta['mime']+"/"+str(meta['len']))
```
```
# store signature + preview=false
```

nora: UX: show a small "truncated" pill on each log row + an audit-guarded "view truncated sample" action that requires inspector role + records an audit entry. don't load the sample inline by default.

maria: perfect. i also want a metric `truncation_to_investigations_ratio` so SRE can see how often truncation blocks debugging.

sam: can we also emit a sample-rate hint in the event for auto-replay tooling? e.g. `replay_hint: {recommended_sample_rate: 0.01}` so Optimize can suggest batching/rewind.

linda: legal ok with replay hints as long as they don't link to raw content and audit trail exists.

maria: ok — i'll include both the `log_mode` API docs and console mockups in the RFC. thanks all :thumbsup:

ash: small follow-up: who gets permission to flip tenant-level `log_mode`? product or support? we should default to product + org-admin for flips, support can request via escalation flow.

maria: noted. i'll add ACL proposal. assigning now and will sync with security on the RBAC bits.

nora: i'll prototype dashboard tiles this week and link to RFC when available.

maria: thanks — i'll drop the RFC link here once created: https://go/internal/rfc/log-trim-mode (WIP)

sam: thumbs up.
